label: Minimum time in KiwiSaver before a first-home withdrawal
context: A member must have been in KiwiSaver for at least this long before withdrawing funds to buy a first home.

label: Amount that must stay in the account after a first-home withdrawal
context: A member must leave this much in their KiwiSaver account. Funds transferred from an Australian complying superannuation scheme cannot be withdrawn.

subject_intro: When a KiwiSaver member can take savings out to buy a first home, what can be withdrawn, and how much has to stay in the account.
subject_meta_description: You must be in KiwiSaver for {fact:nz_ksfh_years} before a first-home withdrawal, and {fact:nz_ksfh_left} has to stay in your account. See what you can take out and who to ask.
